questions.questionText: What is this?
questions.successQuestion: Tell us a story about a cat. Did you ever have a pet cat when you were younger? What was its name?

questions.questionText: Who barks?
questions.successQuestion: Did you have a pet dog growing up? What kind of dog was it? What tricks could it do?

questions.questionText: Where does this animal live?
questions.successQuestion: Have you ever seen an elephant in person? Maybe at a zoo or on a trip? What do you remember about it?

questions.questionText: What is this colorful bird?
questions.successQuestion: Have you ever heard a parrot talk? What words or phrases do you remember them saying?

questions.questionText: Who says 'Moo'?
questions.successQuestion: Did you ever visit a farm when you were young? What do you remember about seeing cows?

questions.questionText: Where does this animal live?
questions.successQuestion: Have you ever been to the ocean? Have you seen dolphins playing in the water?

questions.questionText: Who gallops and wears a saddle?
questions.successQuestion: Have you ever ridden a horse? If so, where was it? What did it feel like?

questions.questionText: Where does this bird live?
questions.successQuestion: Have you ever seen a penguin in a zoo or on TV? What do you think about how they waddle?

questions.questionText: What is this insect that starts as a caterpillar?
questions.successQuestion: Do you remember chasing butterflies as a child? What colors were your favorite?

questions.successQuestion: Did you ever eat fresh pineapple? Did you like it sweet or sour?

questions.questionText: What tropical fruit has smooth skin and a big seed inside?
questions.successQuestion: Did you eat mangoes as a child? Were they easy to peel?

questions.successQuestion: Did you ever drink coconut water? Did you like the taste?
